title: Architectural Drainage
description: A civil engineering team is analyzing an elevation profile of a mountain pass to determine how much rainwater can be pooled in structural crevices after a heavy storm. Given an array of non-negative integers representing elevation bars of width 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
input_format: An array of non-negative integers height representing the elevation map.
output_format: An integer representing the total units of trapped water.

examples.explanation: The above elevation map is represented by array [0,1,0,2,1,0,1,3,2,1,2,1]. In this case, 6 units of rain water are being trapped.
Water is trapped across the valleys between the peaks.
Valleys trap 3 units at index 1 and 4 units at index 3, totaling 7 units.
